subject: HYBRD is now Mileset (nothing you need to do)
message:
Hey {name},

Quick heads up: HYBRD Running is now called Mileset. Same app, same plan, same data, same Founding 100 deal. You're still free for life.

The only thing to do: if you saved the app to your home screen, delete the old HYBRD icon, open app.hybrdrunning.com and add it again so it shows the new name.

New this week: you can plan for a race even if it's only days away, any sport counts (pickleball too), you can choose treadmill or outside for each run, and you can run with just your phone. No watch needed.

Our Instagram is still @hybrdrunning for now and will switch to @milesetapp soon. Questions or ideas? Just reply. I read every one.

Matthew
